related_synthesis_entries.claim: Most realized gain comes from jointly improving the certificate and error use; surrogate mismatch can be repaired by rescoring, whereas increasing verified height alone appears to approach a finite ceiling inside the method.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The ceiling is an empirical fit under fixed choices and is not a general impossibility result for all parameter changes or zero-free-region techniques.
